name: acquisition-os
description: Customer Acquisition OS monorepo — Sprint 1 authentication

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @acquisition-os/design-tokens && npm run build -w @acquisition-os/fixtures && npm run build -w @acquisition-os/ui && npm run build -w @acquisition-os/product-frames
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @acquisition-os/api && npm run build -w @acquisition-os/web-app && npm run build -w @acquisition-os/web-marketing
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @acquisition-os/api && npm run lint -w @acquisition-os/web-app && npm run lint -w @acquisition-os/web-marketing
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @acquisition-os/api && npm run typecheck -w @acquisition-os/web-app && npm run typecheck -w @acquisition-os/web-marketing
scripts.test: npm run build -w @acquisition-os/design-tokens && npm run test -w @acquisition-os/design-tokens && npm run build -w @acquisition-os/ui && npm run test -w @acquisition-os/ui && npm run test -w @acquisition-os/api && npm run test:isolation -w @acquisition-os/api
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
